Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below, we will follow up with internal redlines:

1) Invoicing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) will issue invoices by default; we can add an entity-mapping clause to route invoices to our EMEA subsidiary where required, but that requires an executed appendix to the order form.

2) VAT / withholding: standard position is customer is responsible for withholding unless a local tax treaty or gross-up is negotiated. We can include a withholding clause and show examples.

3) Staged invoicing: we can support splitting the committed ARR into up to three invoices. We need to specify milestone dates and minimum-commit enforcement (e.g., pro-rated true-up or acceleration).

4) Net terms: finance prefers Net45 for new enterprise customers, but willing to consider Net30 for a signed PO + credit approval.

Attaching a request for internal redlines — Ben/Kimberly, could you please propose: (a) exact invoicing language for entity mapping; (b) recommended net terms and early-pay wording; (c) VAT/withholding clause options. Once we have that, Mark will legal-redline and we can share back with Liam.

Ava / Kim —

Draft recommendations (put together for Mark's review):

- Invoicing entity clause (new section): "Invoices will be issued by Redwood Inference, Inc. unless an Entity Routing Appendix is executed specifying an alternate Redwood legal entity for invoicing and tax treatment. Customer must provide a signed Entity Routing Appendix and valid invoice remittance details 30 days prior to the first scheduled invoice to enable alternate invoicing."

- Staged invoicing: allow up to three invoices for the committed amount with milestone dates tied to the subscription start, 90 days, and 180 days. Minimum commit enforcement: any unused portion of a committed tranche will be billed as a true-up at the end of year at the contracted rate (no discounts applied retroactively).

- Net terms: recommend default Net45 for enterprise orders. For Net30 requests, require: (i) an executed PO referencing the order number; and (ii) completion of Redwood credit-screening questionnaire (attached). Early pay: add optional 1.5% discount for payments within 15 days.

- Withholding: customer bears responsibility for withholding; customer must provide evidence of tax withholding rates and remit any gross-up amounts for payments where gross-up is required by law. Include indemnity for incorrect withholding.

I've attached orderform_redline_v1.docx with tracked commercial changes. Once legal confirms, we can send to Stellaris.
